name: Thaumaturgy (Path of Technomancy) — 2 Intermediate — Remote Access

system.description: Spending a Willpower Trait lets you operate any electronic device in your line of sight directly with your mind, without touching it, for a number of turns equal to your Path of Technomancy score before requiring a Simple Test each turn to maintain the connection. Only a single device may be operated at a time, and if the device is destroyed while in use, you immediately suffer three levels of unhalved bashing damage.
